citations.excerpt: This council was held at Constantinople (5 May-2 June, 553), having been called by Emperor Justinian.

facts.value: Council called by Justinian that condemned the Three Chapters.

citations.excerpt: Eight sessions were held, the result of which was the final condemnation of the Three Chapters by the 165 bishops present at the last session (2 June, 553)
